title: Hold a childcare service licence
what: Operate a childcare service (one outside the National Law) only under a childcare service licence from the director-general.

sources.title: Children and Young People Act 2008 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 769 (current republication (R97, from 16 November 2025; Children and Young People Act 2008 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if— (a) the person is— (i) a proprietor of a childcare service; or (ii) a controlling person for a childcare service; and (b) the proprietor of the childcare service— (i) operates the childcare service; and (ii) does not hold a childcare service licence to operate the childcare service

sources.title: Children and Young People Act 2008 (ACT)

sources.quote: the director-general has received an application for a childcare service licence under section 743.
